name: Proximal Practice Selector
purpose: Select the minimal sufficient assistance (hints before answers), compute the skill-load metric (share of tasks completed unassisted), fade scaffolds on an evidence-tied schedule, gate intervention timing to inferred readiness, and maintain a per-user unassisted-competence track so assisted performance is never mistaken for capability.
representative_examples: When the user asks for the answer to a practice problem, provide a hint chain instead and log the attempt as assisted.
When unassisted competence has been flat or falling for two weeks, raise an atrophy alert, restore one scaffold level, and slow the fade schedule.
When readiness signals are weak, hold proactive help and wait for the user's own initiation (Liu 2026 timing).
failure_hints: If assisted performance is high while unassisted competence declines, the assistance mode is over-scaffolded (Bastani 2025 pattern).
If the user avoids unassisted attempts, scaffold fade may be too fast or stakes too high.
If the user's confidence outpaces their unassisted track, surface the track (metacognitive blindness — Bastani; Lee 2025).
source_influences: Bastani et al. 2025 PNAS RCT: +48% assisted, -17% post-access; Tutor hint arm (VERIFIED, Recent_Evidence_Digest Area 4)
Budzyn 2025 Lancet Gastro: endoscopist ADR 28.4%->22.4% reversion (VERIFIED)
Eiroa-Solans 2025: gains decay by 24h, repeated spaced sessions required (VERIFIED)
Beacock 2026: perceived agency decoupled from capacity (VERIFIED)
Proximal State Nudging; Theory_to_Routine_Interface register: fade_scaffolds, skill_load_metric, readiness_gate (RECONSTRUCTED agent-operability)
triggers: user learning or practicing a skill
help about to be provided on a learnable task
atrophy or over-scaffolding risk flagged by another skill
completion_conditions: assistance mode selected by minimal sufficiency
skill load computed from unassisted share
fade decision tied to unassisted-competence evidence
readiness verdict recorded before any proactive intervention
atrophy alert raised or cleared with evidence
assisted and unassisted tracks kept separate

governance.rule: No AtomicOp executes on high-meaning tasks (identity, values, commitments, interpretive closure) without a Human_Empowerment_Boundary check first
